title: import-payload emits single next_command
summary: import-payload emits next_command (apply/escape-hatch/bootstrap/adopt) and seeds .agentic/releases/unreleased/README.md so adoption core_ready is reachable after local import without a bare mkdir gap.
migration_impact: Additive only. Clients reading next_steps continue to work; prefer next_command for agent routing (parity with adopt/self-migrate).
agent_notes: After import-payload --json, follow next_command. Apply seeds releases/unreleased layout required by assess_adoption_readiness. .plate remains bootstrap/human (JSON schema v1.2) — not seeded by import.
